name: practice-lab-tests
description: Playwright + TypeScript test suite for Practice Lab (dhanoapartners.com): UI, API, accessibility, SVG, banking, and training samples for self-healing, RAG, LLM-as-judge, AI agents and failure triage.

scripts.test:ui: playwright test specs/shop.spec.ts specs/checkout.spec.ts specs/playground.spec.ts specs/hover.spec.ts specs/site.spec.ts
scripts.har:record: cross-env UPDATE_HAR=1 playwright test specs/network.spec.ts -g HAR
scripts.demo:broken: cross-env LAB_UI=v2 playwright test specs/healing.spec.ts -g plain
scripts.demo:healed: cross-env LAB_UI=v2 playwright test specs/healing.spec.ts -g fallback
scripts.demo:triage: cross-env TRIAGE_DEMO=1 playwright test --retries=1 || tsx triage-basic/triage.ts
